source_definition: have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
usage_note: 用作系动词，连接形容词或表语名词；具体中文随语境调整。

source_definition: occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere
usage_note: 表示处于某处或某位置，不代表所有 be 的用法。

source_definition: have ownership or possession of
usage_note: 表示拥有或持有；与助动词用法分开。

source_definition: have as a feature
usage_note: 表示具有某种特征；译法随上下文调整。

source_definition: change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
usage_note: 表示从一处移动或前往，亦可有引申用法。

source_definition: move away from a place into another direction
usage_note: 表示离开某处向其他方向移动。

source_definition: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
usage_note: 表示获得具体或抽象的事物。

source_definition: reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
usage_note: 表示经过移动或进程到达目的地。

source_definition: enter or assume a certain state or condition
usage_note: 表示进入某种状态；具体形容词含义依语境确定。

source_definition: express in words
usage_note: 指用语言表达；不涵盖全部引申用法。

source_definition: be familiar or acquainted with a person or an object
usage_note: 指熟悉某人或某事物；与知道事实的义项区分。

source_definition: be cognizant or aware of a fact or a specific piece of information; possess knowledge or information about
usage_note: 指知晓事实或具体信息。

source_definition: create or manufacture a man-made product
usage_note: 指创造或制造人造产品。

source_definition: cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
usage_note: 指促使某人做某事或以某种方式行动。

source_definition: use or exercise the mind or one's power of reason in order to make inferences, decisions, or arrive at a solution or judgments
usage_note: 指运用思维或推理作出判断、决定或寻找解决办法。

source_definition: expect, believe, or suppose
usage_note: 表示相信、假定或预期；需根据具体语境选择译法。

source_definition: an instance or single occasion for some event
usage_note: 表示事件发生的一次或一个场合。

source_definition: a reading of a point in time as given by a clock
usage_note: 指钟表显示的某个时间点。

source_definition: perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight
usage_note: 通过视觉感知，或具有视觉能力。

source_definition: perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
usage_note: 在头脑中理解某个观点或情况。

source_definition: (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively
usage_note: 复数用法，统称一群人。

source_definition: the body of citizens of a state or country
usage_note: 指一个国家或地区的公民整体，具体译法依语境。

source_definition: a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days
usage_note: 包含 365 天或 366 天的一段时间。

source_definition: a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity
usage_note: 日历年中用于特定活动的固定时段，如学年。

source_definition: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
usage_note: 具有令人满意或积极的特性，具体译法依所修饰对象。

source_definition: morally admirable
usage_note: 用于道德上值得赞赏的人或行为。

source_definition: move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
usage_note: 朝某人或某物移动、行进或靠近。

source_definition: reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
usage_note: 经过移动或进程抵达目的地。

source_definition: the occupation for which you are paid
usage_note: 指获得报酬的职业或工作。

source_definition: exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity; work
usage_note: 为目的或出于需要进行体力或脑力劳动。

source_definition: perform as expected when applied
usage_note: 指应用时按预期运行。

source_definition: put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
usage_note: 为特定或固有目的而使用某物。

source_definition: what something is used for
usage_note: 指某物被用于什么目的。

source_definition: get into one's hands, take physically
usage_note: 用手取得或拿住实物。

source_definition: travel or go by means of a certain kind of transportation, or a certain route
usage_note: 乘坐某种交通工具或沿某条路线行进。

source_definition: require (time or space)
usage_note: 指需要一定的时间或空间，译法依上下文。

source_definition: receive willingly something given or offered
usage_note: 愿意接收别人给予或提供的东西。

source_definition: perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards; look
usage_note: 把目光转向某物并注意观察。

source_definition: give a certain impression of being something or having a certain aspect
usage_note: 给人某种外观或印象。

source_definition: feel or have a desire for; want strongly
usage_note: 表示对某事物有愿望或强烈愿望。

source_definition: transfer possession of something concrete or abstract to somebody
usage_note: 把具体或抽象事物转交给某人。

source_definition: give as a present; make a gift of
usage_note: 将某物作为礼物给予。

source_definition: not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered
usage_note: 指刚出现、制成、获得或发现不久。

source_definition: unaffected by use or exposure
usage_note: 指没有受到使用或暴露影响的。

source_definition: how something is done or how it happens
usage_note: 指事情如何完成或发生。

source_definition: a line leading to a place or point
usage_note: 指通向某地或某点的路线。

source_definition: come upon after searching; find the location of something that was missed or lost
usage_note: 搜寻后找到丢失或错过的事物所在。

source_definition: make a discovery, make a new finding
usage_note: 发现某事物或作出新的发现。

source_definition: the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside
usage_note: 日出后、日落前户外明亮的时间。

source_definition: a day assigned to a particular purpose or observance
usage_note: 为某个目的或纪念活动指定的一天。

source_definition: a separate and self-contained entity
usage_note: 独立存在的实体，具体所指依语境。

source_definition: have or feel a need for
usage_note: 表示有或感到有某种需要。

source_definition: anything that is necessary but lacking
usage_note: 指必需但缺少的事物。

source_definition: a young person of either sex
usage_note: 指年幼的人。

source_definition: a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age
usage_note: 指人的儿子或女儿，不限年龄。

source_definition: let something be known
usage_note: 使某事为他人所知。

source_definition: narrate or give a detailed account of
usage_note: 叙述或详细说明某事。

source_definition: any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)
usage_note: 所选词网义项描述长尾灵长动物；动物分类与无尾猴等范围须专业复核。

source_definition: polished surface that forms images by reflecting light
usage_note: 指表面反射光线并形成影像的物体；比喻义另行核验。

source_definition: small thin inflatable rubber bag with narrow neck
usage_note: 所选义项指可充气的小型薄橡胶袋；大型载人气球等义另行处理。

source_definition: free of noise or uproar; or making little if any sound
usage_note: 所选义项指声音很小或没有噪声；活动平静等含义另行处理。

source_definition: disappear gradually
usage_note: 所选动词义项指逐渐消失；颜色褪去等含义另行核验。

source_definition: the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference
usage_note: 所选义项指通过圆心、连接圆周两点的线段长度；几何用法须区分线段与长度。

source_definition: marked by correspondence or resemblance
usage_note: 表示具有相似或对应之处；具体相似程度依语境。

source_definition: a line of people or vehicles waiting for something
usage_note: 所选义项指等待的人或车辆排成的队伍；计算机队列义另行核验。

source_definition: a cylindrical vessel, typically used for storing food
usage_note: 所选义项指圆柱形容器，常用于储存食品；其他形状或用途依语境核验。

source_definition: being of the achromatic color of maximum lightness; having little or no hue owing to reflection of almost all incident light
usage_note: 所选义项指白色；其他与颜色不同的用法另行核验。

source_definition: having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
usage_note: 所选义项指具备满足任务所需的条件或资源；中文搭配依语境调整。

source_definition: the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists
usage_note: 所选义项指通过提问或交谈获取信息，常由记者进行；求职面试义另行核验。

source_definition: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion
usage_note: 所选义项指将其他形式能量转为机械能以产生运动的机器；具体设备名称依语境。

source_definition: mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers; usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area; a modern version of the traditional marketplace
usage_note: 所选义项指由多家商铺组成的商业场所；步行街等其他义项另行核验。

source_definition: involving competition or competitiveness
usage_note: 所选义项涉及竞争；有竞争力的等具体搭配另行核验。
